name: MLE-bench
description: Machine-learning engineering tasks derived from real Kaggle competitions.
descriptionZh: 取自真实 Kaggle 竞赛的机器学习工程任务基准。
frontier: 16.9% in Oct 2024 (o1-preview + AIDE) to 64.4% in Feb 2026 (Gemini 3 with retrieval and agent scaffolding)
frontierZh: 2024 年 10 月为 16.9%（o1-preview + AIDE），2026 年 2 月升至 64.4%（Gemini 3 配合检索与 Agent 脚手架）
credibility: The 64.4% figure is achieved with retrieval and agent scaffolding, so it measures the system rather than the model. Note that MLE-bench Lite is a separate, higher-scoring configuration and should not be quoted interchangeably.
credibilityZh: 64.4% 是在检索与 Agent 脚手架加持下取得的，衡量的是整个系统而非模型本身。另需注意 MLE-bench Lite 是另一套口径，分数更高，不可混用。
keyFact: MLE-bench scores rose from 16.9% in October 2024 with o1-preview plus AIDE to 64.4% in February 2026 with Gemini 3 using retrieval and agent scaffolding — a system-level figure, not a bare-model one.
keyFactZh: MLE-bench 分数从 2024 年 10 月 o1-preview + AIDE 的 16.9%，升至 2026 年 2 月 Gemini 3 配合检索与 Agent 脚手架的 64.4%——这是系统级数字，而非裸模型成绩。
